descriptionChirho: A raised area or swelling on the skin, used in Levitical priestly diagnosis of skin diseases (Lev 13-14); the physical, medical sense of elevation on the body's surface.
Elevated status, grandeur, or honor; the abstract sense of being 'lifted up' in rank, authority, or splendor, used of kings, rulers, and God.
The action or event of rising or being lifted up, preserving the verbal force of the root nasa' (to lift/carry); used of physical rising or upward movement.
